description: The 12 most recent grid posts of a public Instagram account: shortcode, URL, type (image/carousel/video), full caption, post time, likes, comments, video duration, location and image URL, plus followers. Only the newest 12 (no paging, no comment text, no video view counts). Private accounts return an empty list. Unknown users 404; a failed fetch 503 (not charged). Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_instagram_reel when you need Recent videos and reels of a public Instagram account; social_instagram_contact when you need Public contact details of an Instagram account. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
